data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=d_r-kQMaWlwQ7kNvgEGoSea&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAQsnsfmikoy5pI13_dCSNYd1b4wUG7w4SU60SLR539LA&oe=672DF69C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=z2I0boFmPagQ7kNvgEF3tGp&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCKehttcZ85zyXS8GkHeVw1na8qMZq0WOt2lBznzLQ__A&oe=672E0024)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=6QyaEtxc-ScQ7kNvgFegjyc&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCVFaaGoUmujXKgrRzp1svuExdBzCVceAV-qRLc8lz97g&oe=672DE787)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=F-aq3mwrn7gQ7kNvgFYtvTT&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYASRUyg8lvjq8sfbjMThVC7di70CEl0riDhqoncCQUiTw&oe=672DDA66)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=5ljfUkGjFRUQ7kNvgEmOpFb&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB5q9oBmPS_jKp92erUxqV_NyYn_kl4ZvPM31sGUEkcSQ&oe=672E06D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=G2PIBkgrHhgQ7kNvgFkJbWC&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAlraRtLMZZikOwci_2gw-ensCsavD9qtgR2VISEGQCzw&oe=672E0359)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=miTym6xW2jwQ7kNvgEzTAzz&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAG-ly9nf4fA6kTc0iE5qJX7_K3Rb3aaJVdCYhfXl_sSg&oe=672DE970)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=BSEerBM0f1IQ7kNvgFPOiLc&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAJr0QegAzxL7bLeeW3_4Rxkhxnc15mgnXT8nqlATBuUg&oe=672E0C2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=10sSY2M7W4QQ7kNvgHhWgPU&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDR62ENSb1FbmkAVpN_XjDfG3Y0L1bZjYxekmX82NaFfg&oe=672DE797)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=uYzYz6lFDacQ7kNvgGCobMc&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBpP-muxRcjx3W9KsTYaz6KLugz1ytxdNnaGP6yJ7DZxw&oe=672E030C)
